coxa_yaw._status: software range about the radial zero; positive = counter-clockwise about body +z

femur_pitch._status: derived from the CAD kinematics for simulation; replace with measured hardware stops. Zero = CAD pose (femur 46 deg above horizontal), positive raises the femur; horizontal at -0.804, straight up at +0.767

tibia_pitch._status: derived from the CAD kinematics for simulation; replace with measured hardware stops. Zero = CAD pose (74 deg knee interior angle), positive opens the knee; fully closed at -1.29, straight at +1.851 (interior angle = 74.3 deg + q)

_convention: Endpoints are MOTOR positions at the shared CAD zero of the leg reference; motor 3 drives the push lever and the parallelogram carries its delta 1:1 to the knee.
